regions.merged_text: Pedler gives up Drink - Starts managing Store. Emil Henderson (Convert) of Manhassett L.I. Enrolled January 6th peddling every day and drinking everythin. This was Sunday - following Thursday got steady work in a store - stopped drinking and now has been managing the business for over a month.

regions.merged_text: Cured from Gangerin Diabetes Patrick P. McCue 993 Boston Rd. N. Y.C. Enrolled for one year 9th of Feb., by fellow motor-man - against Diabetes and gangerine - went to BelleView Hospital - Re- ported To-day entirely cured of both, and working everyday - doc- tors baffled! McCue had signed papers that in case his gangree- nous toe were not enough they might cut off the leg if necessary.
